summary: The rent promised by a developer has to cover income the owner will lose from people already doing business there.
realLife: Penn Central’s agreement for offices above Grand Central promised annual payments, but the project would displace concessionaires whose rents already supported the railroad.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with owner, tenant, rent. A board member can ask which existing tenants the revenue projection assumes will leave.

turns.what: One displaced concessionaire accepts space in the rebuilt station.
turns.pulledBy: The lease offers a replacement stall with enough room for that tenant.
turns.writesBack: The owner's revised projection keeps that rent and drops the rest.
